# AMULET

> AMULET is a natural alkaline mineral water brand (pH 8.2) produced and
> distributed by Birta Impex SRL in Salonta, Bihor County, Romania. It is
> sold in 1.5L PET bottles and 19L reusable containers, with home delivery
> in Salonta, Oradea and Arad (Romania). The website is available in
> Romanian (default) and Hungarian.

## Key facts

- Brand: AMULET (apă alcalină / lúgos ásványvíz)
- Producer/distributor: Birta Impex SRL, CUI 34585600, Nr. Reg. Com. J2015000863054
- Water source: izvorul B-128, Mezőkovácsháza
- pH: 8.2 (label spec, ±0.5); lab-measured 8.38 by Aqua Labor (Hungary)
- Certifications: ISO 9001 (quality management), ISO 14001 (environmental management)
- Products: 1.5L PET bottle (3 RON + 0.5 RON SGR deposit), 19L reusable container
  (35 RON with an empty container exchanged, 75 RON without)
- Delivery: free above 150 RON, in Salonta (Mon-Thu), Oradea (Mon & Wed), Arad (Thu)
- Payment: cash/on delivery only, no online payment
- Contact: +40 741 597 436, amulet@amulet.ro
- Warehouse: Str. Mărășești nr. 7, Salonta, jud. Bihor (Mon-Fri 8:00-16:30)
- Registered office: Piața Transilvaniei nr. 7, 415500 Salonta, jud. Bihor
